provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: The landing md/given.md#claim-given.steps directly introduces Given statement stepping. Links machine configurations, full expression evaluation in both prose and the Let premise, and finished configurations. State-binding notation is a local adjunct to this single Let rule. The public wrapper additionally links collection and initial-frame exit, distinguishing it from the local statement operation. The Let premise links expression evaluation. K is linked to machine configuration; the output binding and fresh-variable dom condition are explained as local rule notation. Public transitions collect after local evaluation or pop an exhausted frame; these rules define the wrapper in place. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
